about_the_game:
At the edge of the universe lies an oracle house, home to a witch named Luna and a cat with a strange meow called Beebo. As you focus on your work or studies, the melody of time transforms into the radiant light of stars. Use this stellar energy to exchange for exquisite outfits and decorations, dress up Luna and Beepo, and create a cozy, serene corner that reflects your personal style. Sometimes, mysterious travelers are guided by the stars to this place, weaving dreamlike tales of romance and warmth with you.

In Lite Mode, Beebo will lounge in the corner of your screen, providing constant companionship to drive away fatigue. In Full Mode, Luna and Beebo will work or study with you, focusing on helping you concentrate.

As you progress through your focus sessions, you'll earn a variety of rewards! Use these to dress Luna and Beebo in unique outfits or decorate the Dream Oracle House to create your own dream space.

Will the mysterious guests who come quietly bring wonderful adventures, thorny challenges, or warm greetings?

Every choice you make will rewrite the trajectory of fate. The unique personality traits of the guests will be refined into crystals; those unforgettable memories will be transformed into collectible paintings, infusing eternal vitality into the Dream Oracle House.
